question: Where was the 15th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship 2025 held?

options.text: Major Dhyan Chand Hockey Stadium, Jhansi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Dhyan Chand Hockey Stadium, Jhansi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 15th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship was held from April 4 to 15, 2025, at the Major Dhyan Chand Hockey Stadium in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The tournament features a division-based format with three levels: A, B, and C.**
 
• **Promotion and relegation battles have been introduced to increase competitiveness.**
 
• **Top Indian teams participated in Division A, including Hockey Association of Odisha and Hockey Haryana.**
 
• **Division A matches started from April 8, while Divisions B and C began on April 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Hockey Stadium, Jhansi**__

 __
 
• Named after India’s legendary hockey player Major Dhyan Chand.
 
• Located in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Hosting the 15th edition of the Senior Men National Championship.
 
 
 
• **Other Stadiums for Reference**__
 
 
• **Kalinga Stadium, Bhubaneswar:** Frequently hosts international hockey events.
 
• **Birsa Munda Stadium, Rourkela:** One of the largest hockey stadiums in India.
 
• **Dhyan Chand National Stadium, New Delhi:** Historic venue used during the 2010 Commonwealth Games.
